name: adversarial-review-capability-spec
title: Spec: adversarial multi-lens review capability (dimensional lenses + per-finding adversarial verification + completeness critic)
description: Produce docs/adversarial-review-spec.md — a contract-first design spec for an adversarial multi-lens review capability in Lattice, codifying the methodology that empirically out-performed single-pass review during the parallel-decomposition gate program. The methodology: (1) DIMENSIONAL LENSES — N independent review agents each reviewing one facet (concept/quality/behavior/test-coverage/crash-safety/…); (2) PER-FINDING ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION — each raw finding is judged by M independent skeptics who default to refute; a finding counts only on a majority confirm, killing plausible-but-wrong findings; (3) COMPLETENESS CRITIC — a dedicated agent that asks 'what did the review MISS?' and can reopen a round. The spec defines the data shapes (finding, verdict, lens), the convergence criteria, how it integrates into Lattice's existing review (lanes + full-3x2 escalation) as a new escalation tier / review mode, the MVP vs future split, and the implementation-story breakdown. It cites the concrete empirical evidence (BLOCKER/MAJOR-class bypass doors the completeness critic found on S4/S5/the metadata story that single-pass Codex review missed). This is the doc deliverable; implementation is a follow-on program the spec defines.
